description: 심사 fixture(영상 A). Meet 전사에서 사용자가 한 약속("I'll send the revised proposal to Jordan by Friday.")만 내 할 일이고, 상대가 한 약속("I'll book the follow-up call next week.")은 뽑지 않는다. 사용자 줄의 이름표는 Taskforce 프로필 이름(2-5).

sources.text:
[Google Meet · Proposal review — Acme]
Jordan Lee: Thanks for the draft. Could you revise the pricing section?
Alex Kim: Sure. I'll send the revised proposal to Jordan by Friday.
Jordan Lee: Great. I'll book the follow-up call next week.

evidence.quote: I'll send the revised proposal to Jordan by Friday.
Could you revise the pricing section?

must_not_extract.quote: I'll book the follow-up call next week.
